Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)
Referred Sections: CMM-609.8: Repeat Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) at the Same Level
Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft
Required findings: Post‑operative imaging demonstrates malposition or failure of the implant/instrumentation or structural bone graft (e.g., migration, pedicle screw breakage, loosening, dislodged hooks, rod breakage, rod bending, loss of curve correction, decompensation, etc.)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.8 > Malposition or Failure of Implant/Instrumentation or Structural Bone Graft

Required findings: ≥ 6 months since the prior lumbar fusion.
Daily pain causing clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing).
Physical examination findings concordant with the reported symptoms.

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement with BOTH of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription‑strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or NSAIDs for 6 weeks; and a provider‑directed exercise program for 6 weeks.
Post‑operative imaging performed ≥ 6 months after the prior fusion showing pseudoarthrosis at the requested level(s).
Post‑operative MRI/CT findings concordant with the individual’s symptoms.
Absence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid or alcohol use disorder).
Documentation of nicotine‑free status: never‑smoker or abstinent from all nicotine products for ≥ 6 weeks, verified by objective cotinine testing (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range.

Important criteria & exceptions: Nicotine‑free status must be verified by objective cotinine testing.
Unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders exclude medical necessity.
Documentation required: Post‑operative imaging report (X‑ray, CT, or MRI) demonstrating malposition/failure or pseudoarthrosis.
MRI/CT report confirming findings concordant with symptoms (for pseudoarthrosis).
Detailed physical examination documentation correlating with symptoms.
Record of pharmacologic trial (prescription analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, NSAIDs) for at least 6 weeks.
Documentation of a supervised exercise program for at least 6 weeks.
Cotinine test results confirming nicotine‑free status for ≥ 6 weeks.
Mental/behavioral health assessment confirming absence of unmanaged disorders.
